performance.detail: Combined comb~/allpass~ scalar pair at cap40 and authored gain0.5; effect cannot be split between those two operators. Reference: float32-strict; candidate: float32-audio-v2. working.detail: Authored scalar pair and selected signal-delay cases work within their stated caps/gains. Comb/allpass pair, cap40ms, authored gain0.5, impulse/min/max; separate signal-delay exact-conversion fixture adds bounded modulation. Computer-only public admission reproduces the complete previously measured64,376-byte modulee026c4f9...; strict Main44100/256/cap40, per-sample Float32 durations, RNE, faithful Double fallback, no other options. Four historical target cases reused; no new device execution. Computer-only current-runtime public admission exactly reproduces both full measured55,172-byte modules7117/e24f. Strict Main44100/256/cap40 scalar duration, exclusive owned state/RNE; historical3-case output/timing reused, current18native workloads kept separate.
